feature.light_limit_fix.shadow_culling.0: 0 disables small actor-part shadow culling. Positive values set the maximum bounding-sphere radius of an eligible part and its projected shadow, not its diameter. Default: about 11.42 cm. Larger values allow more parts to qualify. Distance, camera-motion, near-light and projected-size safeguards still apply.

0 disables small actor-part shadow culling. Positive values restore shadows when the actor returns within this distance, plus the fixed movement margin. Default: 6.426 m before the margin. Equal positive cutoff and return distances remove the return band. All three small-part sliders must be positive to enable this rule.

0 disables small actor-part shadow culling without changing the return distance. Positive values start omitting eligible shadows beyond this actor distance, plus the fixed movement margin. Default: 7.14 m before the margin. A positive cutoff below the return distance also lowers the return distance. All three small-part sliders must be positive to enable this rule.
